Use body 20px, heading 48px, line height 1.3, reading measure at most 56ch, gap 48px, content width at most 1120px and item radius 2px. Set headings in Young Serif and reading text in Work Sans; warm expressive serif with open functional sans. Build for this brief: A software product; users scan records and complete repeated tasks. At 390px use a single reading order, preserve required text and provide access to every control. Use real subject imagery when needed, not ornamental blobs.
